Imagine you have a pair of **magic coins**. 

Normally, if you flip two coins, the result of one has nothing to do with the result of the other. If Coin A is heads, Coin B could be heads or tails. They are independent.

But these magic coins are **entangled**. This means they are linked by a mysterious connection, regardless of how far apart they are.
